query: EB2 (and adjacent) I-485 RFE -> approval gap, RFE-material-agnostic
definition: gap_days = days from 'RFE response received' to 'I-485 approved'. context flags whether file was already at terminal adjudication (multi-FTA1/AR) vs early-stage (biometrics/interview still pending) — the dominant driver of the gap.

cases.note: EB3 original, IOE09265, PD 2019-08, no interview, FO=LA County. RFE=polio vaccine. 'Response received' -> approved = 1 DAY. NOTE: 6-week lag between mailing response and USCIS logging 'response received' — but Theo is ALREADY past that (status shows received 7/20). Event codes IKA(RFE)->HA(response received)->H008(approved) — Theo currently shows HA, same as this case right before approval.

analysis.note: Terminal-adjudication RFE-response->decision gaps (each RFE cycle counted): [5, 7, 10, 30, 56] days, median 10, range 5-56. The 159d case (784496) is early-stage (biometrics pending after RFE, pre-2022 I-944 regime) and excluded. RFE material varied (birth cert, medical form, marital+employment, unspecified, ×2) — gap is driven by file STAGE not RFE type. The two IOE09343 cases (1176936, 1166519) are the strongest analogs to Theo (China EB2, PD 2021-04/05, adjacent receipt block, no interview): 7d/10d and 56d.
analysis.eb2_eb3_only_note: EB2 + EB3 only (NIW excluded per Theo). Terminal-adjudication gaps now include EB3 (1d, IOE09265) alongside EB2.

consensus.source: Google AI Overview (Law Offices of Peter D. Chu + Reddy Neumann Brown + Reddit trackers), pulled 2026-07-20
consensus.eb2_concurrent_rfe_to_approval: typically 30-60 days; occasionally 7-14 days; long tail 90-180 days only if further administrative review needed
consensus.material_agnostic: timeline depends on concurrent-with-I-140 adjudication, background checks, and PD-current — NOT on the RFE material type
consensus.eb_job_offer_rfe: Reddy Neumann Brown: the EB continuing-job-offer RFE "often prompts an approval or a decision within days"

prediction_for_theo.profile: China EB2 PERM, PD 2021-05, IOE09357, concurrent, no interview, 3 FTA0 + 3 FTA1 (terminal adjudication), RFE response received 2026-07-20
prediction_for_theo.primary_estimate: RFE-response-received (2026-07-20) -> decision most likely within ~1-8 weeks; median comparable ~10 days, realistic band 1 week to ~2 months (late July through mid/late September)
prediction_for_theo.basis: 5 primary DPs at terminal adjudication: gaps [5,7,10,30,56] days, median 10. Two strongest analogs (IOE09343 block, China EB2, PD 2021-04/05, no interview) = 7d/10d and 56d. Matches EB2-concurrent consensus 30-60d typical / 7-14d fast.
prediction_for_theo.terminal_signal: silent I-485 updatedAt bump OR 485J-close -> approval within ~24h (holds across all corpus approvals)
prediction_for_theo.downside: Charlotte bottom-decile EB throughput (0.23x national) could stretch to the 56d-and-beyond tail; a further admin-review RFE could reach 90-180d (low odds, RFE was routine)
